text:
Seedance prompt

Create a 15-second cinematic fantasy adventure video. Strictly follow the storyboard sequence in exact order. Do not skip, merge, reorder, or replace any panel. Maintain perfect continuity of the blonde woman, red-and-black uniform, Coca-Cola bottle, park environment, lighting, and emotional progression throughout the entire video.

STYLE:
Photorealistic cinematic realism, Unreal Engine quality, warm golden-hour sunlight, realistic blonde hair physics, shallow depth of field, cinematic bokeh, lens flares, smooth camera movement, volumetric lighting, high-detail textures, film-quality color grading, dreamlike fantasy atmosphere.
MAIN CHARACTER:
Beautiful adult Western woman, shoulder-length blonde hair, blue eyes, stylish red-and-black uniform, confident, playful, adventurous personality. Appearance remains identical in every scene.

PANEL 01 (0:00–0:02) — "A SUMMER BREAK"
Wide establishing shot of a peaceful sunny park. The blonde woman sits comfortably on the grass beneath large trees. Warm golden sunlight shines through leaves. She holds an ice-cold Coca-Cola bottle and enjoys the relaxing summer atmosphere.
Dialogue:
"Perfect day for a little break."
PANEL 02 (0:02–0:04) — "THE FIRST SIP"
Extreme cinematic close-up. Condensation glistens on the Coke bottle. She slowly takes a sip. Golden sunlight sparkles through the glass. Camera pushes in toward her face.
Dialogue:
"Mmm... refreshing."

PANEL 03 (0:04–0:05.5) — "THE MAGIC BEGINS"
The environment subtly distorts. Light particles appear around her. Background softly warps as if reality is becoming a dream. She looks around with curiosity. The park begins feeling magical and surreal.
Woman whispers:
"Wait... what's happening?"
PANEL 04 (0:05.5–0:07) — "SHRUNK!"
Sudden reveal: she is now miniature. Extreme high-angle shot. Tiny woman stands on a giant tree branch surrounded by enormous leaves and towering blades of grass. She looks amazed at her new scale.
Dialogue:
"No way... I'm tiny!"
PANEL 05 (0:07–0:08.5) — "GIANT PICNIC WORLD"
Top-down cinematic shot. She explores a giant picnic table. Massive apples, cakes, juice bottles, and a huge Coca-Cola can surround her like skyscrapers. She runs between the giant objects in wonder.
Dialogue:
"Everything is gigantic!"
PANEL 06 (0:08.5–0:10) — "BUMBLEBEE RIDE"
A giant fluffy bumblebee lands nearby. She climbs onto its back. The bee lifts off smoothly. Dynamic tracking shot follows them rising above the picnic table.
Dialogue:
"Let's go!"

PANEL 07 (0:10–0:11.5) — "SKY ADVENTURE"
Epic aerial sequence. The bee flies through glowing clouds and golden sunlight. Her blonde hair streams behind her in the wind. Massive cinematic scale. Smooth drone-like camera movement around them.
Woman laughs joyfully.
PANEL 08 (0:11.5–0:13) — "CHAOTIC FUN"
The bee races through a children's splash fountain. Huge water droplets burst around them. Fast-paced action, playful energy, dynamic camera angles, exciting near misses, sparkling sunlight reflections.
Woman shouts:
"This is amazing!"
PANEL 09 (0:13–0:15) — "BACK TO REALITY"
Smooth magical transition. She is normal size again, lying peacefully on a grassy hill during sunset. She takes one final sip of Coca-Cola and smiles directly at the camera. Warm sunlight illuminates her blonde hair. The fantasy adventure fades away.
Dialogue:
"Best summer day ever."
ENDING SHOT:
Hold on her satisfied smile. Warm sunset glow. Gentle breeze moving her hair. Cinematic fade-out to black.

IMPORTANT:
Strictly follow all 9 panels in exact sequence.
One continuous story.
Consistent character design and clothing.
No scene omissions.
No extra scenes.
No character changes.
Smooth transitions between panels.
Professional cinematic storytelling from beginning to end.
content:
Specify the exact video length (e.g., 15 seconds) and break it into timestamped storyboard panels to control pacing and shot progression.  
Instruct the model to follow the storyboard panels in exact order and explicitly forbid skipping, merging, reordering, replacing, or adding scenes to enforce sequence adherence.  
Lock continuity by explicitly stating which elements must remain identical throughout (character appearance, clothing, key prop, environment, lighting, emotional progression).  
Define a dedicated STYLE block with concrete cinematic keywords (photorealistic, Unreal Engine quality, golden-hour sunlight, shallow depth of field, bokeh, lens flares, volumetric lighting, film-quality color grading) to steer visual quality consistently.  
Include per-panel shot/camera directives (wide establishing, extreme close-up, high-angle, top-down, dynamic tracking, drone-like movement) to control composition and camera motion.  
Add explicit transition instructions (smooth transitions between panels; smooth magical transition back to reality; cinematic fade-out to black) to reduce abrupt cuts.  
Provide per-panel dialogue/whispers/shouts to anchor the intended emotional beats and timing across the sequence.

translations.es:
Especifica la duración exacta del video (por ejemplo, 15 segundos) y divídelo en paneles de storyboard con marcas de tiempo para controlar el ritmo y la progresión de las tomas.  
Instruye al modelo para seguir los paneles del storyboard en el orden exacto y prohíbe explícitamente saltar, fusionar, reordenar, reemplazar o añadir escenas para asegurar la adherencia a la secuencia.  
Asegura la continuidad indicando explícitamente qué elementos deben permanecer idénticos a lo largo del video (apariencia del personaje, vestimenta, objeto clave, entorno, iluminación, progresión emocional).  
Define un bloque de ESTILO dedicado con palabras clave cinematográficas concretas (fotorrealista, calidad de Unreal Engine, luz dorada de la hora mágica, poca profundidad de campo, bokeh, destellos de lente, iluminación volumétrica, gradación de color de calidad cinematográfica) para guiar la calidad visual de manera consistente.  
Incluye directrices de toma/cámara por panel (establecimiento amplio, primerísimo primer plano, ángulo alto, vista cenital, seguimiento dinámico, movimiento tipo dron) para controlar la composición y el movimiento de la cámara.  
Añade instrucciones de transición explícitas (transiciones suaves entre paneles; transición mágica suave de regreso a la realidad; fundido cinematográfico a negro) para reducir cortes abruptos.  
Proporciona diálogo/susurros/gritos por panel para anclar los golpes emocionales y el ritmo previsto a lo largo de la secuencia.
translations.fr:
Spécifiez la durée exacte de la vidéo (par exemple, 15 secondes) et divisez-la en panneaux de storyboard avec des horodatages pour contrôler le rythme et la progression des plans.  
Instruisez le modèle à suivre les panneaux du storyboard dans l'ordre exact et interdisez explicitement de sauter, fusionner, réorganiser, remplacer ou ajouter des scènes pour garantir le respect de la séquence.  
Assurez la continuité en précisant explicitement quels éléments doivent rester identiques tout au long (apparence des personnages, vêtements, accessoire clé, environnement, éclairage, progression émotionnelle).  
Définissez un bloc STYLE dédié avec des mots-clés cinématographiques concrets (photoréaliste, qualité Unreal Engine, lumière dorée de l'heure dorée, faible profondeur de champ, bokeh, lens flares, éclairage volumétrique, étalonnage des couleurs de qualité film) pour orienter la qualité visuelle de manière cohérente.  
Incluez des directives de prise de vue/caméra par panneau (plan large d'établissement, gros plan extrême, angle élevé, vue de dessus, suivi dynamique, mouvement de type drone) pour contrôler la composition et le mouvement de la caméra.  
Ajoutez des instructions de transition explicites (transitions fluides entre les panneaux ; transition magique fluide de retour à la réalité ; fondu cinématographique au noir) pour réduire les coupures abruptes.  
Fournissez des dialogues/murmures/cris par panneau pour ancrer les moments émotionnels et le timing prévu tout au long de la séquence.
translations.ja:
---
正確なビデオの長さ（例：15秒）を指定し、タイムスタンプ付きのストーリーボードパネルに分けて、ペースとショットの進行を制御します。  
モデルにストーリーボードパネルを正確な順序で従うよう指示し、シーンのスキップ、結合、並べ替え、置き換え、追加を明確に禁止して、シーケンスの順守を強制します。  
連続性を維持するために、キャラクターの外見、衣装、主要な小道具、環境、照明、感情の進行など、どの要素が一貫して同一でなければならないかを明示的に示します。  
具体的なシネマティックキーワード（フォトリアリスティック、Unreal Engine品質、ゴールデンアワーの太陽光、浅い被写界深度、ボケ、レンズフレア、ボリュメトリックライティング、映画品質のカラーグレーディング）を用いた専用のSTYLEブロックを定義し、視覚的な品質を一貫して導きます。  
各パネルごとのショット/カメラ指示（ワイドエスタブリッシング、極端なクローズアップ、ハイアングル、トップダウン、ダイナミックトラッキング、ドローンのような動き）を含めて、構図とカメラの動きを制御します。  
明確なトランジション指示（パネル間のスムーズなトランジション、現実へのスムーズな魔法のトランジション、シネマティックなフェードアウトからブラックへ）を追加して、急なカットを減らします。  
各パネルごとの対話/ささやき/叫びを提供して、シーケンス全体の意図された感情的なビートとタイミングを固定します。  
---
translations.ko:
---
정확한 비디오 길이(예: 15초)를 지정하고, 속도와 장면 진행을 제어하기 위해 타임스탬프가 있는 스토리보드 패널로 나누세요.  
모델에게 스토리보드 패널을 정확한 순서대로 따르도록 지시하고, 순서 준수를 위해 장면을 건너뛰거나, 합치거나, 재배열하거나, 대체하거나, 추가하는 것을 명시적으로 금지하세요.  
연속성을 유지하기 위해 캐릭터의 외모, 의상, 주요 소품, 환경, 조명, 감정의 진행 등 동일하게 유지해야 할 요소를 명확히 명시하세요.  
일관된 시각적 품질을 유도하기 위해 구체적인 시네마틱 키워드(포토리얼리스틱, 언리얼 엔진 품질, 황금 시간대의 햇빛, 얕은 심도, 보케, 렌즈 플레어, 볼류메트릭 조명, 영화 품질의 색상 그레이딩)로 구성된 전용 스타일 블록을 정의하세요.  
구성을 제어하고 카메라 움직임을 조절하기 위해 패널별 샷/카메라 지시사항(넓은 설정 샷, 극단적인 클로즈업, 높은 각도, 탑다운, 동적 추적, 드론 같은 움직임)을 포함하세요.  
갑작스러운 컷을 줄이기 위해 명확한 전환 지침(패널 간의 부드러운 전환; 현실로의 부드러운 마법적 전환; 시네마틱 페이드아웃 투 블랙)을 추가하세요.  
시퀀스 전반에 걸쳐 의도된 감정적 비트와 타이밍을 고정하기 위해 패널별 대사/속삭임/외침을 제공하세요.
translations.pt-BR:
Especifique a duração exata do vídeo (por exemplo, 15 segundos) e divida-o em painéis de storyboard com marcação de tempo para controlar o ritmo e a progressão das cenas.  
Instrua o modelo a seguir os painéis do storyboard na ordem exata e proíba explicitamente pular, mesclar, reordenar, substituir ou adicionar cenas para garantir a adesão à sequência.  
Mantenha a continuidade declarando explicitamente quais elementos devem permanecer idênticos ao longo do vídeo (aparência dos personagens, roupas, objeto chave, ambiente, iluminação, progressão emocional).  
Defina um bloco de ESTILO dedicado com palavras-chave cinematográficas concretas (fotorrealista, qualidade Unreal Engine, luz do sol da hora dourada, pouca profundidade de campo, bokeh, flares de lente, iluminação volumétrica, gradação de cor de qualidade cinematográfica) para direcionar a qualidade visual de forma consistente.  
Inclua diretrizes de tomada/câmera por painel (abertura ampla, close-up extremo, ângulo alto, de cima para baixo, rastreamento dinâmico, movimento semelhante a drone) para controlar a composição e o movimento da câmera.  
Adicione instruções de transição explícitas (transições suaves entre painéis; transição mágica suave de volta à realidade; fade-out cinematográfico para preto) para reduzir cortes abruptos.  
Forneça diálogos/sussurros/gritos por painel para ancorar os momentos emocionais pretendidos e o timing ao longo da sequência.
translations.zh-CN:
指定确切的视频长度（例如，15秒），并将其分解为带有时间戳的分镜面板，以控制节奏和镜头进展。  
指示模型严格按照分镜面板的顺序进行，并明确禁止跳过、合并、重新排序、替换或添加场景，以确保顺序的遵循。  
通过明确说明哪些元素必须在整个过程中保持一致（角色外观、服装、关键道具、环境、灯光、情感进展）来锁定连续性。  
定义一个专门的STYLE块，使用具体的电影关键词（写实、Unreal Engine质量、黄金时刻阳光、浅景深、散景、镜头光晕、体积光、电影级色彩分级）来一致地引导视觉质量。  
在每个面板中包含镜头/相机指令（广角建立镜头、极端特写、高角度、俯视、动态跟踪、无人机式运动）以控制构图和相机运动。  
添加明确的过渡指令（面板之间的平滑过渡；平滑的魔法过渡回到现实；电影般的淡出至黑）以减少突兀的剪切。  
提供每个面板的对话/低语/喊叫，以锚定预期的情感节奏和整个序列的时间安排。
